verdict.rationale: Baseten is an inference platform that deploys open-source and custom models from frameworks such as transformers. A community report describes running embedding workloads on Baseten for vector-DB querying, so embeddings plausibly stay in-vendor. However, no first-party doc names an embeddings endpoint, and reranking is never mentioned. Missing for 10: first-party embeddings API or docs, any reranking capability, hosted Model APIs for embedding or rerank models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor

citations.quote: Developer notes that with Baseten.co embedding workloads, the client (not server) becomes the bottleneck
Deploy an open-source, fine-tuned, or custom model on dedicated GPUs.
